name: deeperas
description: Clarify intent, verify facts, and refuse premature answers.

interface.shortDescription: One useful question at a time
interface.longDescription: Resolve explicit alternatives and material choices with one explained question at a time. Check available evidence before answering or acting. R33 includes a core skill and five required topic references. X and List shorthand controls are ChatGPT-only; natural-language requests work across hosts.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Deeperas to clarify the choices that matter before answering.
